replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Evidence shows email-only sign-up and dual $10 credit; concrete mass farming attack on credit budget."},{"id":"T2","keep":true,"reason":"Referral codes exist in design; enumeration/guessing attack distinct from farming own code."},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"Client submits referral code at sign-up; concrete tampering to inflate credit or redirect payout."},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"Self-referral both-sides payout distinct enough; design lacks differentiation rule between referrer and referee."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Email-only sign-up supports account enumeration disclosure; distinct harm from credit fraud."},{"id":"T6","keep":true,"reason":"Email-only records plausibly prevent attributing fraudulent redemptions; distinct non-repudiation harm."}]}
